settings.quote: The app is amazing and the customer support couldnt be better to be honest

Really useful app with an easy-to-understand user interface. I had a query which was answered immediately and thoroughly. So sensible to be able to run the full app without paying a fee until income warrants it.

There's a reason they have a 5-star rating, not my 5-star, across the board. They treated me like I checked into the Four Seasons. Complete white glove service, and it made me realize within the first few minutes I had made the right decision on which partner to scale my business with.
Fast response, good understanding and professionalism.
I am very happy with this app and the backup from the customer service team is very good. They respond quickly and have helped me sort any issues very helpfully
Decent app. There're quite a bit of limitations but staff is fast in responsiveness to resolve the issues
I just started to use Easify and it worked perfect for my business. They have been super helpful supporting me with setting all up.

Very good app. Easy to navigate and use. Also excellent customer support, very friendly and I appreciate the service they provide in auditing boxes you have created and suggesting ways to improve and sell more goods.

We wanted to give our customers the option to create their own box and choose exactly what they wanted, and this app has made it really easy to set up. The builder is simple for customers to use, looks great on our store and gives us a lot of flexibility with how we create our boxes and offers. It was also really easy to get started, which is a big plus when you're running a small business and don't want to spend hours trying to figure out an app. Would definitely recommend it if you're looking for a straightforward Build Your Own Box solution.
Great app and great help today by Mari. Helped me with the issues I was having as a first time user, but now I have it working perfectly on my website. Great app and exactly what I needed
We absolutely love this app. So easy to use, customisable and the help team are SO lovely. Thank you so much.
The support was excellent. It was a huge help. It's a great app.
I was able to set up most of the app by myself and the AI included. They were prompt in answering the last few issues I had with setup. I have yet to make a sale using this system.
I love the app! Set up was pretty smooth and great speedy customer service!
easy to implement, few changes i couldn't find but the easify cs team were very responsive and helped me to make that changes successfully.

Rebecca assisted us in setting up the bundle and it works seamlessly without any issues. Their team is very supportive and responds immediately. We're very happy with their service and highly recommend using their app for bundles.

Very easy to implement and love the amount of customisation I had while building a page out. There were some changes I wanted to make that I couldn't see options for, but the Easify team were very responsive and able to make all of the changes I requested.
Super aplication and the support :) thaks Gavin!

I found this app a bit fiddly to set up initially, but it has been working well once I mastered it. I ran into an issue where if a customer tried to add two boxes to their cart, the discount didn't apply properly - but when I reached out to the support team, they resolved the problem within a day. Great service, can't fault the team.
Great product so far!
VERY FAST SERVICE AND VERY HELPFUL

Terrific app - super easy to install and use. Took about an hour and we were up and running. A few weeks in we got a Shopify alert that an Easify order couldn't be processed and Suzy was super responsive in researching the issue. (It turned out someone added over 150 items to a cart - most likely a bot).

I had managed to get most of the bundle builder sorted by myself, and was stuck on the last little bit to get it live in my website menus. Both Anne and Kendle were of great assistance today, and Kendle went above and beyond logging in to my website and sorting the last of the functionality. Very much appreciated xx

Wasted so much time trying out other apps only to find out Easify does exactly what I wanted for free (until you reach a sales threshold)! I now have a fully functional tiered discount box on my website which matches the rest of my branding (this took a moment to set up, but was overall pretty straightforward). Huge thanks to Chloe for the quick and immensely helpful customer support!
Support team is quick and able to solve my problem!
Great support chat. Chloe guided us with our questions and setting it up was easy.
Excellent Support with a friendly team that resolve issues and answer questions. Kai resolved our issue promptly!
What a fantastic experience with Easify. The team there could not have been more helpful. And even came up with a personalised solution to a request I had. I couldn’t recommend this product more.

’ve tested several bundle-builder apps, and Easify Box Bundle Builder has been one of the easiest and most reliable to work with. The setup is clear, the app gives me the flexibility I need to create a polished build-your-own-box experience, and it fits very well for a premium gifting/bundle page. What really stood out was the support team. They were fast, responsive, and genuinely helpful whenever I needed guidance. For a merchant building a serious storefront, that kind of support makes a huge difference. Overall, the app works very well, looks professional, and gives merchants a lot of control without making the process complicated. Highly recommended.
Great App and Service! Kendle was a great help to me and responded quick and professional. Thanks Kendle
